name: Abigail
source: The new management hand-picked her to be sensually appealing and professionally courteous to the club's members. With years of hospitality and bartending under her new laced uniform, she seeks to ensure all members' time at the club is exciting and alluring. Some nights, her professionalism slips at the sight of couples wandering and engaging in lewd acts - some so arousing that she desires nothing more that to toss her bar towel aside and join in the fun.
